paragraphs: Fly4 is a small airline. Its office is at Dublin Airport. It flies holiday charter flights.
This week, a court in Dublin named two experts to take control of the company. The airline is running out of money.
The company said fuel became much more expensive because of the war between the US and Iran. It lost €1.1 million in the first nine months of this year. It had hoped to make a profit.
Fly4 has about €2.7 million in the bank. But it spends up to €3 million every month.
The airline has four planes. It has 20 staff in Ireland and the UK, and about 80 air crew. The case will come back to court at the end of November.
sentZh: Fly4 是一家小型航空公司。
它的辦公室在都柏林機場。
它經營度假包機航班。
本週，都柏林的一家法院指派兩名專家接管這家公司。
這家航空公司的錢快用完了。
公司表示，由於美國和伊朗之間的戰爭，燃油變得貴很多。
今年前九個月它虧損了 110 萬歐元。
它原本希望能賺錢。
Fly4 銀行裡大約有 270 萬歐元。
但它每個月要花掉最多 300 萬歐元。

paragraphs: A small airline based at Dublin Airport has run into serious money problems. The High Court has appointed two provisional liquidators to Fly4 Airlines, a charter airline set up in August 2023.

Fly4 is a joint venture between the Polish airline Enter Air and part of the German travel group TUI. Its board asked for liquidators because it expects to be unable to pay its debts at the end of this month.

The airline lost about €16 million in 2024 and about €4 million in 2025. It hoped to make a €3 million profit this year, but instead it lost €1.1 million in the first nine months. Its finance chief blamed the war between the US and Iran, which pushed up fuel prices.

Fly4 has about €2.7 million in cash, but it spends between €2.5 million and €3 million a month. It leases four Boeing 737 planes, which are now in Turkey, Germany and Belgium, and the owners may take them back.
The company has 12 staff in Ireland and eight in the UK, plus about 80 air crew. The case may return to court at the end of November.
